cycle_relation.cycle_2_is_eligible_only_after: This cycle reaches terminal RESEARCH_GO on both exact same-season and locked p100 surfaces with every integrity and slice gate passing.

trigger_and_stop_contract.trigger_branch_if_stage1_fails_scientifi: Stage 2 is not required; use the frozen exact incumbent as anchor after the stage-1 result and manifest hashes are pinned.
trigger_and_stop_contract.trigger_branch_if_stage1_passes: Wait for the separately preregistered locked-p100 stage-2 result. Use NCR as anchor only if both original stage-1 and stage-2 gates pass; otherwise use the frozen exact incumbent.
blocked_if: stage 1 ended in infrastructure failure without a scientific decision
stage 1 passed but locked-p100 stage 2 is incomplete or infrastructure-failed
required terminal hashes cannot be pinned
source, key, chronology, or leakage integrity check fails
trigger_and_stop_contract.blocked_policy: Stop before trajectory materialization. Infrastructure recovery, if any, requires a separate authorization and cannot alter this design.
trigger_and_stop_contract.terminal_exact_no_go_policy: Stop without locked-p100 evaluation and prohibit P2 cycle 2.
trigger_and_stop_contract.terminal_research_go_policy: Permit only a separately authorized execution of the preregistered P2 cycle 2; do not submit from this design.

hypothesis: A whole-trajectory match of public-layer temperature and salinity can identify historical vertical-curvature regimes that pointwise analogs miss. Transferring only the historical target-layer residual from contemporaneous public-depth linear interpolation, rather than absolute target temperature, can achieve transport-sized improvement while failing closed to the frozen anchor when trajectory support is weak.

immutable_aggregate_inputs.role: exact same-season aggregate comparator and pointwise-analog failure evidence

data_features_target_firewall.allowed_data: Historical labeled P2 training rows, frozen local prediction keys, and public-layer historical covariates only, after a future authorization pins their existing hashes.
query_features: M2 sine, cosine, amplitude, and phase
data_features_target_firewall.training_target: For each target layer, historical truth temperature minus contemporaneous piecewise-linear public-depth temperature interpolation.
data_features_target_firewall.scaling: Robust median and IQR computed only from each historical source prefix; query rows never update scaling statistics.

trajectory_algorithm.residual_aggregation: weighted median at each aligned target-layer timestamp
trajectory_algorithm.weak_support_policy: Return the exact anchor prediction with correction=0.
trajectory_algorithm.source_time_rule: Every source trajectory and its target residual must end at least seven full days before the query trajectory starts.
trajectory_algorithm.projection: Append fixed public endpoints L1 and L5 to candidate L2-L4 and project the five values onto the monotone direction determined by L1 versus L5 while keeping endpoints fixed; if endpoints are equal, project to a constant endpoint value.

leakage_safe_splits.mask_rule: Temperature and salinity for target layers 2, 3, and 4 are jointly hidden throughout each validation window before any feature or trajectory construction.
leakage_safe_splits.selection_rule: Select one of six cells using equal-weight inner-window and layer RMSE only; exact and p100 labels are never used for selection.

fixed_search_and_budget.selection: Minimize equal-weight mean inner-window, equal-weight layer RMSE. Ties resolve by lower worst-window RMSE, then shorter context, then fewer neighbors.

evaluation.comparator: Frozen anchor selected solely by the predecessor branch.
evaluation.primary_metric: row-pooled RMSE in raw degrees Celsius
secondary_metrics: weekly RMSE deltas and p90 regression
fold, layer, season, and distance-by-layer slices

SUBMISSION_GO.note: Research-only decision label; this design creates no candidate and authorizes no submission.

fair_incumbent_control.pointwise_analog_failure_acknowledged: The prior aggregate pointwise TEOS analog delta was +0.049190944 C and regressed every block; this trajectory method is structurally different and receives no relaxed gate because of that failure.

P3_deprioritization.reason: The observed P3 headroom cannot by itself produce the requested 2-3 points. P2 trajectory transfer therefore receives priority while the separately frozen P3 ERA5 experiment remains untouched.

limitations: The exact same-season surface is one 2024 September-October regime and may not represent the hidden regime.
Dynamic time warping can match coincidental public-layer shapes without identifying target-layer hysteresis.
The monotone endpoint projection can oversmooth true inversions.
The locked p100 surface remains a local historical transport proxy, not an official-score oracle.
The point mapping is inferred and the prior pointwise-analog failure makes the expected upside uncertain.
Passing local gates is neither candidate-generation nor upload authorization.
